applications.name: boulevard-watchlist
applications.title: Boulevard Ticker Watchlist
applications.description: Live BBO for a hand-picked list of tickers (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOG, AMZN by default). Clicking a row broadcasts fdc3.instrument context to any connected app on the same channel.

applications.name: boulevard-oms-order-entry
applications.title: Boulevard OMS Order Entry
applications.description: A mock order ticket plus a combined bid/ask depth ladder for whichever ticker is currently active - driven by fdc3.instrument context, or a manual ticker override for standalone use. Submitted orders are broadcast as a custom blvd.order context for boulevard-order-blotter to record.

applications.name: boulevard-order-blotter
applications.title: Boulevard Order Blotter
applications.description: Records every order broadcast by boulevard-oms-order-entry (custom blvd.order FDC3 context) on the same channel. No order state of its own beyond what it's received.

applications.name: boulevard-candlestick
applications.title: Boulevard Candlestick Chart
applications.description: A live candlestick chart for the currently active ticker, built client-side from the BBO midpoint (Boulevard doesn't distribute individual trade prints) - driven by fdc3.instrument context, or a manual ticker override for standalone use.
